rv.q: C.S. Lewis’ iconic tale remains just as relevant and enchanting today, and this production is ideal as an alternative to the many pantomimes this festive season.

Putting aside my few minor quibbles, The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe is a beautifully realised Christmas show and an ideal one for parents who wish to introduce their children to the magic of theatre.
This is a spectacle of a show in every way: set, staging, astounding effects, puppetry and costumes – the lot.
At times thrillingly threatening, often spectacular and frequently charming, this is a richly satisfying show.

cn.t: Critics praise this Narnia adaptation as a magical, well-crafted production that successfully transports audiences to the fantastical world, with strong nostalgic appeal and effective staging earning consistently positive reviews.
